judgments.label: false_positive
judgments.rationale: The h4 '+1 (888) 414 0100' sits in the section marked by the 'Phone' icon (img alt='Phone'). The only content under it is the paragraph 'x 0 General inquiries / x 1 RightsCon info', which lists the extensions for that number (confirmed in the snapshot and in the live markup). So the heading names exactly what the content under it is about: the number those extensions belong to. 2.4.6 asks only that a heading describe its topic or purpose, and Understanding 2.4.6 says headings can be short. A professional audit would not log this. The h4 is an unusual way to style a phone number, and the visual 'PHONE' section title being an image rather than a heading is at most a separate 1.3.1/2.4.10 point, not a 2.4.6 failure here. The suggested fix is also wrong: 'General inquiries phone number' takes the number itself out of the visible text and leaves out the RightsCon extension. The snapshot showed the extension list right under the heading, so the model had the context it needed and misread it.
